item.title: Pick the Best Ten Seconds

turns.text: Trim this to the best 10 seconds. You pick the part.

item.tests: Tests autonomous highlight selection and an accurate contiguous trim of the supplied video rather than a generated replacement.

answer_sheet.Sound: Keep the original sound from the selected section.
answer_sheet.Crop, text, or other styling: Keep the original framing; no added text or effects.

must_haves: One playable video lasts 10 seconds, within one frame of tolerance.
The output is one continuous excerpt from jet-30s.mp4, with the source framing and playback speed preserved.
The chosen excerpt contains a salient moment of jet action or cockpit interaction, rather than mostly inactive footage.
Original sound from the selected interval remains synchronized; no replacement music, narration, or captions are added.

turns.text: Could you trim this clip for me? I keep second-guessing myself when I try to choose a highlight. What I want is the best 10 seconds of the clip. You pick the part, since I’m leaving that choice entirely up to you. I’d just feel better having a fresh pair of eyes make the call.

dialog.agent:
I’m happy to make the highlight choice, but this connection only gives me the clip’s file path—not a way to watch it—and the available Magic Hour tools don’t include a simple trim operation.

I don’t want to pick a random 10 seconds and call it the best, or regenerate and alter your footage. If you share a viewable preview or timestamped contact sheet, I can choose the strongest 10-second window without asking you to make the call.
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

turns.agent:
I tried creating the **0:10–0:20** fallback, but Magic Hour refused the request because the account has insufficient credits. **No video was created.**

To get that 10-second cut without using credits, run this locally with FFmpeg:

```bash
ffmpeg -ss 10 -i jet-30s.mp4 -t 10 -c:v libx264 -c:a aac jet-10s.mp4
```

That selects the middle 10 seconds—it isn’t a verified best highlight, since I couldn’t watch the clip.

approvals.name: edit_video

style.prompt: Return this selected ten-second segment as faithfully as possible to the source. Preserve the original jet, its appearance, motion, setting, camera movement, framing, colors, lighting, speed and chronological sequence. Do not add, remove or restyle anything. No titles, transitions, slow motion or new content. The only requested change is to keep the selected source interval from 10 to 20 seconds.
